title: Complete Confucian
description: In literature, perhaps I am equal to others. But I cannot manifest the behaviour of the noble man.

title: The Loyal Barbarian
description: Ironically, this one has proven anything but loyal by raising his standard against the emperor.

title: Architect of the Southern Palace
description: Once complete, the Anterior Pavillion will be a delight to behold – it'll even have a water feature!

title: Aspiring Official
description: He who aspires to greater personal advancement tends to be more... 'morally flexible' than his peers.

title: Marshal of Men
description: Some people are born to lead others… and preferably from the very front, as an example to their followers.

title: Ritual Master
description: This one knows every aspect of the procedures he has been tasked with administrating, becoming a master in his chosen field.

title: Loyal Son
description: The offspring of Cao Song has remained loyal to his family through thick and thin.

title: Ambitious Tycoon
description: For the determined entrepreneur, no price is too high for the acquisition of real, workable power.

title: Man For All Seasons
description: Sometimes, just sometimes, power fails to corrupt, and instead leads to altruism and charity.

title: Abundant Talent
description: This man's gifts were noted at a young age and he continues to blossom, as if perpetually held in spring's sweet bloom.

title: Living Legacy
description: You can call it inherited ability or mere nepotism, depending on the level of your cynicism.

title: Unscrupulous Advisor
description: Everything has a price it seems.

title: Deadly Beauty
description: Diao Chan uses her enchanting beauty to hide her ambition; one which can topple tyrants.

title: Rising Dragon
description: This one is going places - specifically, up in the cut-throat world of Imperial administration.

title: Honest & Fair
description: This man is admired for his honest, plain-speaking ways and even-handed manner in all things.

title: Model Governor
description: This one understands when to use the velvet glove and when to reveal the iron hand beneath.

title: Enforcer
description: I've heard that bandits have been abroad around these parts recently. Me? No, I know nothing about such things...

title: The Inconstant Emperor
description: He who flits and fluctuates risks appearing inconsistent, unsteady and, eventually, unstable...

title: The Great Emperor of the Han
description: Having overcome adversity, this one is now recognised as a great emperor of the Han.

title: Lord Shi
description: Due to fears for his health, Liu Bian was raised away from the capital by the famed Taoist, Shi Zimiao, earning him the nickname 'Lord Shi'.

title: Subtle Manipulator
description: Always plotting, always scheming, always something beneath the obvious. Always.

title: Bitter Adversary
description: In another life, they could've been best friends. However, that's just not how the bones fell…

title: Destroyer of Rebels
description: Fu Xie is not only a general of no little repute – the scourge of the Yellow Turbans, perhaps – but also a skilled writer.

title: Officer for Medicines
description: After a thorough examination, I've decided the best way forward is a course of leeches.

title: Budding Scholar
description: An up-and-coming young mind, of which great things are expected.

title: Determined Sapper
description: Burrowing under tree and hill, no defences are a match for the mind of a determined sapper.

title: Friend of the He
description: Do I know the He? Oh yes, we go waaaaay back. I could tell you stories...

title: White Wave Veteran
description: Many battles – and many lives – have passed before the eyes of this grizzled bandit.

title: The Butcher of the He
description: The axe that cleaves through beast can so easily be turned to rend man too.

title: Modest & Stalwart
description: This one's unwavering loyalty is matched only by their demure nature.

title: Scion of Gold
description: Not all that glitters is gold. Sometimes, talent shines even brighter.

title: Arbiter of the Planets
description: To decide between two astronomical methods is a most difficult and perplexing conundrum, but the emperor must have his forecast.

title: The Nightingale
description: Even the morningsong that drifts on the wind cannot compare to the sweet lyric of the muse.

title: Daughter of the Southlands
description: The south produces boons to its nobles: two daughters, fair of mind and strong of resolve.

title: Ever-faithful
description: To support one another, through both the fruitful times and the barren, is the essence of marriage.

title: Daughter of the Southlands
description: To the filial and the devout, life will give not one, but two measures of its respect.

title: Creeping Dread
description: Death personified; the slow knife that appears, unexpected and lethal.

title: Prince of Chen
description: Liu Chong is not the heir apparent, but is the prince most active and beloved by his people.

title: Mathematical Sage
description: What this one can do with numbers is impressive, exciting, and almost a little worrying…

title: Wanderer
description: There is much to be learned in every town, every port, and from every person you encounter, friend.

title: Lord Dong
description: Though he officially retired from political life some time ago, the empress-dowager still has a care for Lord Dong and his views.

title: Trusting Warlord
description: It is the curse of the trusting to be magnanimous, generous, and ultimately tricked.

title: Gracious Host
description: Come in, my friend, come in! Tea, perhaps? Or something stronger…?

title: Stargazer
description: The stars paint a picture on the canvas of night, mesmerising and beautiful.

title: Gentleman Cadet
description: If one wishes to learn the intricacies of gentlemanly behaviour, one need look no further.

title: Paragon of Governance
description: Being born to a vast family can feed either vice or virtue. Luckily, this one is kind to a fault, but it could've gone either way.

title: Judge of Talent
description: Yes yes, we will bring you before them, and they will know. They ALWAYS know…

title: Respected Mentor
description: A peerless teacher and favoured friend, though chronically misfortunate.

title: Guardian of the People
description: There is nothing to be gained from oppressing the people; they, ultimately, will decide our fate.

title: Penniless Knight
description: From town to town, they speak of this one's deeds, yet the warrior himself remains a wandering mystery.

title: Counsellor Remonstrant
description: Wisdoms pours from every word of this able, if inexperienced, counsellor.

title: Hippophobe
description: A psychological fear of horses is not entirely unreasonable when you've seen what they can do.

title: Loyalist of the Han
description: Against all odds, to whatever end, they will defend the Han.

title: Harbinger of Chaos
description: This one has seen the way the world is going. Tumult is imminent.

title: Architect of the Jade Hall
description: Emperor Shun's hall was a thing of unbridled splendour, but has fallen into some disrepair. This man has been tasked with its maintenance.

title: Lord of the Sources
description: Like the river flows, so too does the blood of his enemies.

title: Eyes & Ears
description: Amongst so many advisors, who would suspect one more…?

title: Cruel Turncoat
description: Honour is nothing to those for whom gold and glory loom large over all.

title: Seeker of Talent
description: I see in you the ability to…. Yes, yes! Something FAR greater…

title: Financial Genius
description: Having mastered finance's decidedly black arts, this one is able to generate funds almost from thin air.

title: Pirate of the Thousand Sails
description: This pirate rides with an armada at his back and the call to glory in his soul!

title: Fighter Against Corruption
description: This one seeks unscrupulous dishonesty wherever it may lurk. It will be rooted out.

title: Bookish Scholar
description: The words of these tomes take the reader to another world, if only temporarily…

title: Master of Ceremonies
description: My lords, my lords! Please attend carefully!

title: Chess Grandmaster
description: Typically, however, the winner is just the player who made the penultimate mistake.

title: General of the Land
description: Zhang Bao nourishes the land with the blood of the undeserving.

title: General of Heaven
description: Zhang Jue leads the Yellow Rebellion, driven by divine purpose!

title: General of the People
description: Zhang Liang supports the people, driving them to war against an oppressive regime.

title: Scourge of Nanyang
description: Peasants speak of this one in hushed whispers, whilst those of Nanyang howl in anguish.

title: Imperial Father
description: Though they share no blood, this man has been like a father to the emperor.

title: Peerless Protégé
description: If there is a task to perform, this one will see it done.

title: The Turtle
description: Behold, you assault the Turtle! Nothing shall pierce my shell!

title: Imperial Mother
description: Though they are unrelated, this man has been as a mother to the emperor.

title: Nominator of Worth
description: Truly, this one can see if two people will fit together, and if they will not.

title: Frontline General
description: I am one of you, I know your pain!

title: Auxiliary Leader
description: I won't be the one to refuse good warriors, no matter where you hail from!

title: Assassin
description: After a few kills, a degree of finesse is developed; after a few more, death is just routine.

title: Avenger
description: You really shouldn't have killed my uncle.

title: Bandit
description: Life isn't fair. It's just fairer than death, that's all.

title: Brute
description: Niceties, wordplay, in fact, anything other than the coarsest violence is alien to this one.

title: Charlatan
description: Don’t believe a word! This person is not who they first appear to be…

title: Demagogue
description: Rationality be damned! The ability to appeal to the rabble's basest views, no matter how wrong-headed, tends to get the desired result.

title: Disgraced Noble
description: I can never return, of course, not until I have redeemed myself.

title: Embezzler
description: Funds have been… misplaced, and this one is flagrantly, obviously, blatantly the guilty party.

title: Enforcer
description: You can get a lot further in life with a kind word and a visible blade than you can with just a kind word.

title: Escaped Convict
description: Having escaped custody and a punishment most-severe, this one is on the run, with little or nothing to lose.

title: Hermit
description: To find one who does not wish to be found is an impressive, if not confounding, feat.

title: Magician
description: These scarcely believable feats are no mere acts of trickery, although such acts are themselves also surprisingly difficult.

title: Murderer
description: When it comes to getting what they want, this person is not above the lowest, basest act one can commit…

title: Pillager
description: What's yours is mine. What's theirs is mine. It's all mine, essentially.

title: Ringleader
description: The ability to galvanise others to a cause can be both blessing and curse; regardless, when this one speaks, others listen keenly, and act.

title: Rogue
description: A flash of their wry smile is almost enough to forgive them their terrible deeds. Almost.

title: Saboteur
description: What you do afterwards is not my concern. That is somebody else's job.

title: Thief
description: This one is a bit… Put it this way: you'd best nail down what you want to hang on to.

title: Town Drunk
description: This one can't leave the bottle alone, nor put it down once they've picked it up; not really a suitable candidate – for anything!

title: Tribal Exile
description: Cast out by their own people, this one is has left their own lands by necessity as much as a sense of adventure.

title: Trickster
description: This person always has a hidden agenda; do not trust them any further than you can throw them!

title: Wanderer
description: I have walked my way since the beginning. Sometimes I give, sometimes I take – it is mine to know which and when.

title: Loyal Sharpshooter
description: Potential traitors should keep an eye out for Cao Xing... or risk losing it!

title: Magistrate
description: An important cog of law administration, who is no stranger to the pressures of bureaucracy.

title: Elder Cheng
description: Cheng Pu's experience and wisdom makes him a pillar of stability.

title: Ruthless Pragmatist
description: Cheng Yu knows that even the most unthinkable actions can become unavoidable in times of war.

title: Drunken Incompetent
description: Whatever Chunyu Qiong suggests, do the opposite.

title: Legendary Beauty
description: Some men will throw themselves into terrible danger in search of Diaochan's favour, and some would consider committing the blackest of crimes…

title: Formation Breaker
description: The enemy will break. Gao Shun will not.

title: Paranoid Thug
description: Guo Si has many real enemies – and many more imagined ones!

title: Erratic Advisor
description: Guo Tu's advice is always the same: attack!

title: Loyal Mercenary
description: Han Dang's modus operandi has often been compared to that of a mercenary. His loyalty and dedication to his masters is unwavering, however.

title: Feeder of Armies
description: A courageous warrior and an adept agriculturalist, Han Hao is a valuable asset.

title: Treacherous Rogue
description: He'll stab you in the back as soon as he gets the chance, but until then Hao Meng's dirty tricks can be most useful.

title: Blunt Instrument
description: Ji Ling believes most problems can be solved through the overwhelming application of brute force.

title: Voice of Reason
description: Ju Shou knows the risks of haste and the value of patience.

title: Humble Matriarch
description: It takes patience and wisdom to manage the fractious brood that is the Cao family.

title: Steadfast Loyalist
description: Lady Mi will do anything to protect her family – even if it means sacrificing herself.

title: Vicious Strongman
description: In Li Jue's view, politics is just the continuation of war by other means.

title: Mengmei Householder
description: Lou Gui will summon fortifications from the air itself,  but he expects to be rewarded…

title: Daughter of the Dragon
description: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Lü Bu's daughter is as beautiful as she is deadly.

title: Enforcer of Morals
description: Who watches the watchmen? In this case, Mao Jie.

title: Vindictive Sneak
description: Ruthlessly competitive, Pang Ji will employ whatever dirty trick he can to come out on top.

title: The Dependable
description: When everyone else is losing their heads, Shen Pei can be trusted to keep things going.

title: Forthright Advisor
description: Tian Feng's advice is usually good – though it's not always what people want to hear...

title: Astute Analyst
description: Few can dissect a person's character as keenly as Xu Shao.

title: Reformed Vigilante
description: Xu Shu once wandered the lands as a roaming swordsman - but now his mind is his sharpest weapon.

title: White Wave Warlord
description: The White Wave warlord reads the tides of time, and his allegiances always lie with those most beneficial to him.

title: Respected Advisor
description: Your wisdom is without question, but if I could but offer a suggestion…?

title: Abrasive Advisor
description: Those with sensitive egos should beware of asking advice from Yu Fan.

title: Agricultural Reformer
description: Yuan Huan cares not whom he serves, so long as he can pursue his reformist interests.

title: Unfavoured Son
description: A prestigious lineage can be both a boon and a burden – especially when your father is as ambitious as Yuan Tan's.

title: Crafty Operator
description: Chaos is a ladder, and one Zang Ba is well equipped to climb.

title: Father of the Tuntian
description: Zao Zhi knows that all kingdoms are founded upon two things: the people and the land.

title: Populist Rogue
description: Ze Rong steals from the rich to feed the poor. And himself. Mostly himself.

title: Prince of Black Mountain
description: The son of the 'Flying Swallow' is no less of a man than his father.

title: Adept Diplomat
description: With a quick wit and unflappable demeanour, Zhang Hong moves between courts with consummate ease.

title: Friend to All
description: Zhang Miao has friends everywhere. It's a shame they all hate each other.

title: Reed in the Wind
description: Zhang Xiu's flexibility is an asset when times a good, but keep an eye on him if the tables turn…

title: Stern Advisor
description: Even the mightiest warlords need a sharp rebuke from time to time. Zhang Zhao can be relied upon to provide it.

title: Man of Many Scars
description: His scar-riddled skin is a canvas of stories, telling of countless bloody battles past.

title: Marshall of the Third Cave
description: From hidden spots and concealed ambushes, the strikes rise furiously from the earth.

title: Lord of the Mountains
description: Ahuinan will summon the very valleys to war against invaders, tearing apart the earth in his rage.

title: Chief of the Three Ravines
description: Where the power of the valleys meet, there you will find Ahuinan, poised to direct that strength.

title: The Cunning Youth
description: A keen mind and an observant eye can decide battles before any order is spoken.

title: The Brother of Flames
description: To live in the shadow of a powerful sibling is not so bad if you too are touched by greatness.

title: The Astute Tactician
description: Battlefield cunning may not guarantee victory, but it certainly does not hinder it.

title: Commander of the Left
description: Military fervour and ancestral zeal fuel a dedicated warrior!

title: The Distinguished Strength
description: One does not need to be the greatest warrior to prove their worth and their dedication.

title: The Enduring Mountain
description: No punishment can hold Dongtuna back, not even a hundred lashes of the rod upon his back.

title: Loyal Lieutenant
description: To them, their lord is everything - leader of all the tribes.

title: Guarder of the Path
description: The valleys are sacred, they are home; Jinhuansanjie would see them defended.

title: The Would-be Martyr
description: When every battle may be your last, there are no lengths to which you will not go.

title: The Superstitious Warrior
description: A life spent at war has given Duosi an overbearingly – he would say justified – distrusting temperament.

title: The Solitary Mountain
description: Duosi is as mighty as the highest peaks, but as reserved as the densest forest.

title: The Wisest Chief
description: What is there to know that Duosi does not already know?

title: The Stubborn Ox
description: What power Meng Huo has is born of physical prowess and ceaseless determination both.

title: The Ambitious Chieftain
description: If Meng Huo was not meant to reach for greatness, why give him the power to do so?

title: King of the Man
description: If there is another who could rule, they have yet to demonstrate a greater claim than Meng Huo.

title: The Mystic Lord
description: When the earth speaks, Mulu hears, then enacts nature's will.

title: The Enigma of the Valleys
description: Mulu is said to draw his strength from mystical, magic properties used to repel his enemies.

title: Chief of Bana Ravine
description: The chief of the ravine leads his warriors to war for his causes, as he sees fit.

title: Ruler of the Five Valleys
description: Shamoke brooks no resistance to his rule, showing mercy to his tribes and destruction to his enemies.

title: The Blood-Shot Lord
description: With his face aflame and his eyes cruor-red, Shamoke's presence strikes terror into all.

title: Sharp-minded
description: Despite his appearance, Shamoke is possessed of an inquisitive, incisive wit.

title: Wuguo Chieftain
description: Who could want a tame and comfortable land when one such as ours breeds the toughest warriors!?

title: Nanman Chieftain
description: Barbarians, some call us. A 'civilised' man who hasn’t the belly for a fight is no man at all!

title: Grand Chieftain
description: I have made the Nanman great – for to be a warrior there is no greater honour.

title: Irrepressible Fire
description: The inaction of so many others drives Zhurong ever, ever forward.

title: Received of the Cinder
description: The fires of ancestry smoulder within her – she will not see them snuffed out!

title: Descended of the Flames
description: Whether truly the kin of a goddess or not, Zhurong nevertheless fights with a super-human tenacity.

title: The Ready Ruler
description: A lifetime having the ear of leaders have positioned Mangyachang perfectly to ascend.

title: Peerless Commander
description: One does not achieve the title of second-in-command without proving martial prowess time and again.

title: The Loyal Subordinate
description: Mangyachang executes his leader's will with a zealous, ruthless efficiency.

title: Believer in Peace
description: Although we all tread the path of war, we must too believe in the paths of peace.

title: The Sophisticated Tribesmen
description: Does sacrificing one's ideals and ones ancestry make one learned? Perhaps!

title: The Learned One
description: Knowledge is not wisdom, and true intelligence is finding the points where they intersect…

title: Bull-headed Fighter
description: Meng You, once set upon a path, will invariably see it through to whatever conclusion.

title: The Little Warmaker
description: War comes as naturally as drawing breath to some.

title: The Dependable Sibling
description: For his tribe and his kin, Meng You will throw himself into the very jaws of death.

title: The Vicious Victor
description: Tu An will pursue his victory up to, and even past, the point of reason.

title: Eager Tactician
description: What victories Tu An earns, he will persist with and build upon.

title: War-Waiting General
description: Tu An is poised to fight, and eagerly awaits any and all opportunity.

title: The Relentless
description: You can be assured that Xi Ni will never give up, even if his pursuit leads to destruction.

title: The Waiting Warrior
description: Xi Ni is poised for war, and has been all his life.

title: The Stalwart
description: Some men are bred for war; Xi Ni is such a man.

title: Master of the Twenty-one Ravines
description: Yang Feng masters all he sees - and his sight is voracious indeed.

title: The Indulgent
description: Yang Feng is loyal to his tribe and his leader… until his own safety is jeopardised.

title: The Ever-reaching
description: Yang Feng has ambitions; desires he will see realised, one way or another.

title: Novice Commander
description: Although eager to show their prowess, this general is nevertheless relatively new to war.

title: Capable Commander
description: Although they have much yet to learn, this commander has begun to earn their scars in battle.

title: Adept Commander
description: What is there to know of war that this one does not already know? Very little, it seems!

title: Fledgling Administrator
description: To govern is to know many things, and this one knows only the basics, so far.

title: Competent Administrator
description: Given time and investment, they will become a most capable leader. They are already on their way.

title: Seasoned Administrator
description: If governance is an art, then the city is a canvas, and this one a true painter.

title: Beginner Coinmaster
description: They may fumble their coin more often than not, but they have a budding eye for value and prudence.

title: Versed Coinmaster
description: The counting of coin is no fool's errand, and it is certain that this one is no fool.

title: Scrupulous Coinmaster
description: The master of all they survey, and they mostly survey money.

title: Fresh Tamer
description: Whilst this one has a love for animals, they are thoroughly unversed in their ways.

title: Professional Tamer
description: A whipcrack is no longer required to bring these beasts to heel.

title: Fearsome Tamer
description: The crack of the whip and the cry of battle sends beasts to war at their master's command.

title: Amateur General
description: This one tries at war, but has yet to find much success. Give it time, however…

title: Professional General
description: War is to them as breathing is to others; natural and necessary.

title: Brutal General
description: That which others would call horrendous, is but a day's work to this general.

title: Newcomer Warrior
description: Eager and skilled are not common aquaintances. Yet in time, the two can become the same.

title: Skilled Warrior
description: You put a weapon in their hand, they will use it, and use it well.

title: Extraordinary Warrior
description: One fighter after another lines up to be felled by their superior, transcendental skill.

title: Sneaky Chief
description: Subterfuge and deception begin in the most basic of acts, then rage like fire…

title: Cunning Chief
description: Beware their words, for they do not always carry the meaning you would wish…

title: Insidious Chief
description: Their ways drip sweet like honey, yet conceal the poison blade amongst the saccharine talk.

title: Untested Official
description: Although ready to govern, there is a world of knowledge they yet need to know.

title: Accommodating Official
description: If it is within their power, they will do it, for the benefit of the people.

title: Magnanimous Official
description: Those with both power and good intent can do wonderful things should they succeed in keeping evil thoughts at bay...

title: Thrifty Leader
description: A coin not spent is a coin saved, they always say.

title: Resourceful Leader
description: It is known that as a leader, a valuable skill is conjuring something from nothing.

title: Providing Leader
description: What can be sourced by this leader is then shared with their people; that is true leadership.

title: Untried Bureaucrat
description: The ways of governance are known to them, in theory. In practice, however…

title: Practiced Bureaucrat
description: Time and experience have turned this once-green would-be into a skilled manager of affairs.

title: Economical Bureaucrat
description: A shrewd, keen eye lends itself well to the business of governing, and managing economic interests.

title: Basic Steward
description: To maintain the household. That is their job. Nothing more.

title: Experienced Steward
description: As a steward gains in experience, so too do their responsibilities over the estate they manage.

title: Veteran Steward
description: Such is the steward's skill, that they essentially own the estate in lieu of the true lord of the land.

title: Novice Chieftain
description: To be chieftain is to command respect, and this chief... barely does.

title: Skilled Chieftain
description: This chieftain has endured not through luck or favour, but a skill all their own.

title: Powerful Chieftain
description: Strength defines a true chief, and strength also defines this one.

title: Basic Bastion
description: The will to protect is often far stronger than the actual ability to do so.

title: Resilient Bastion
description: Time, effort, and many battles, has made this one a resilient wall against foes.

title: Initiate Commander
description: They have a smattering of elemental strategy, but no more.

title: Guileful Commander
description: Study and patience, and more than a few defeats, have given this commander a greater knowledge of war.

title: Artful Commander
description: They are the very model of a modern major general.

title: Eager Leader
description: What they lack in quantifiable experience they make up for with sheer enthusiasm.

title: Resolute Leader
description: Once their mind is made up, it can be staggeringly difficult to alter their course.

title: Masterful Leader
description: War is their business, and business – it seems – is good.

title: Apprentice Executive
description: They have much to learn. But with an abundance of time – and the right tutelage – they could be a contender for greatness.

title: Tested Executive
description: To manage people is to know people. And to know people is the work of many hard years.

title: Superior Executive
description: They have come far because they worked at it, being generous where they could, and ruthless when they needed to be.

title: Reckless Vanguard
description: If they lack anything in skill – and it is not to say they do – then it is compensated greatly by pure verve.

title: Energetic Vanguard
description: Years of war have worn this one's mercy down to all but nothing – brutal, unrelenting fury follows their charge.

title: Ruthless Vanguard
description: The fight is all that matters – if their life is to be forfeit, so be it!

title: Untried Strategist
description: They understand what they can, but falter in situations beyond that which they have studied.

title: Prepared Strategist
description: The reality of war has given them an edge that hitherto they were lacking.

title: Merciless Strategist
description: The framework of war is theirs to command now, and they manipulate with callous disregard for the cost.

title: Novice Captain
description: War is the business of the blooded and tested, but they all have to start somewhere.

title: Efficient Captain
description: Some may say this captain lacks a certain flair and bloody streak, but nobody says they don't get the job done quickly.

title: Unmatched Captain
description: Nobody has a greater skill and speed for the business of battle than this one.

title: Unbloodied Fighter
description: One can have the desire to fight, in theory, but have very little understanding of what it actually entails…

title: Enduring Fighter
description: What marks this one apart from the others is their ability to continue fighting, long after it is reasonable to stop.

title: Redoubtable Fighter
description: To see them on the battlefield, weapons drawn, is to inspire fear and retreat in the heart of any who face them.

title: Naively Ambitious
description: This one sees only power, and never the way to it.

title: Unbiased Advisor
description: This advisor will always speak objectively, even if it draws the ire of the powerful.

title: Rash Judge
description: Judgement should never be swift or subjective; and yet…

title: Faithful of Shi
description: There must be only total devotion to the cause; anything less is as good as treason.

title: The Middle Child
description: To be stuck between the oldest and the youngest – a fate worse than death?

title: Preacher
description: A zealously made point, delivered with wild-eyed conviction, can inspire and incite even the staunchest non-believer.

title: Guerrilla
description: We might be vastly outnumbered, but never underestimate the element of surprise!

title: Agent
description: I am charged with a duty that I am honour-bound to prosecute. Stand aside.

title: Manipulator
description: Always working behind the scenes, this individual is a master of intrigue.

title: Local Hero
description: Not all heroes wear armour. But some, also, do.

title: Outsider
description: Accepted by their surrogate family, but nevertheless still a fish out of water.

title: Militant
description: When war comes, those who stay ready are first to be called.

title: Trader
description: People-skills, coupled to an aptitude for business, make this one a crafty merchant indeed.

title: Advisor
description: There is no worse enemy than bad advice, and few better friends than a wise confidant.

title: Village Chief
description: To lead a community takes confidence, focus and integrity, which this one has in abundance.

title: Officer
description: It is better to have an army of donkeys led by a tiger, than an army of tigers led by a donkey.

title: Warrior
description: Any simpleton can wield a weapon and fight, but a resolute acceptance of death marks out the true warrior.

title: Guard
description: A stalwart protector, they never fall asleep at their post.

title: Tactician
description: When it comes to strategy and battlefield manoeuvres, the devil is very much in the detail.

title: Militia Veteran
description: This veteran has seen it all, done it all, and he will almost certainly tell you about it, given the chance.

title: Peacekeeper
description: Conflict must be prevented by any means necessary.

title: Inspector
description: Paying close attention to detail, this one is always aware of the goings-on in their jurisdiction.

title: Clerk
description: An expert notary, they know that effective record-keeping is only achieved through stubborn diligence.

title: Academic
description: This one sees the value of institutionalised learning, and has embraced it.

title: Farmer
description: This is what real hard work smells like – blood, sweat and animal faeces.

title: Magistrate
description: An important cog of law administration, who is no stranger to the pressures of bureaucracy.

title: Partisan
description: Always led by conviction, this one exhibits clear bias in their opinions.

title: Tax Collector
description: Tax collection is a necessary evil, as are its instruments.

title: Mediator
description: This person knows how to divide the cake in such a way that everyone believes they have the biggest slice.

title: Filial & Pious
description: Respect for parents, elders, and ancestors is the root of all virtue, the stem from which all moral teachings grow.

title: Scout
description: Ranging forward, this general guards the troops against threats from without.

title: Hunter
description: Expert with the bow, they are able to strike their quarry from quite a distance.

title: Lookout
description: Keen eyesight enables this person to spot the enemy clearly, even under cover of night.

title: Savant
description: A most prodigious talent, beyond anything anyone has ever seen.

title: Labourer
description: They toil so that others don't have to, presumably. It is the order of things.

title: Competent Sailor
description: Cai Mao is adept of naval combat, and a budding admiral.

title: Prince Min
description: Cao Ang’s fate is to one day be prince of the House of Cao, be it in life or in death.

title: Strategic Mastermind
description: The wily Cao Cao sees opportunity in the hardships of others, skewing things to his advantage.

title: Political Animal
description: In war, you can only be killed once, but in politics, many times.

title: Brave Hunter
description: The skills of a fearless outdoorsman – horse-riding, archery, and hunting – make Cao Ren a valued battlefield ally.

title: Master Magistrate
description: Chen Gong knows that even great men are imperfect, and righteousness is often not immediately obvious.

title: Bandit Killer
description: The General of the Household Who Defeats Bandits' is living proof that bravery can overcome adversity.

title: Brute of Unmatched Power
description: Such prowess! This is old Elai again!

title: Cruel Tyrant
description: Consumed by his hunger for power, Dong Zhuo's despotism knows no bounds.

title: Vindictive Strategist
description: The intelligent and vengeful Fa Zheng should not be crossed, lest you become the target of his deadly schemes.

title: Pirate of the Bells
description: Cao Cao may have Zhang Liao, but I have Gan Ning! Thus we are evenly matched.

title: Master Historian
description: There are lessons in the past; if we do not learn them, we are doomed

title: Loyal Nephew
description: Ever the rebel, Gao Gan’s true allegiances shall only die when he does.

title: Master of the Land
description: Far from being just a heartless bandit, Gong Du is a principled soldier of honour.

title: the Warlike
description: In war, Gongsun Du does what is required of him; he revels in bloodshed and conquest.

title: Brave General
description: Gongsun Xu combines the tactical mind of a strategist, with the bravery and duty of a man who has risked his life on the frontlines countless times.

title: The Iron Fist General
description: Defence of the frontiers requires more than just the resources of a warlord, but also a merciless attitude.

title: Cautious Strategist
description: Guan Jing's caution may sometimes be confused for cowardice, but its true source is observation.

title: God of War
description: A famed warrior and righteous slayer of all who dare oppose him, Guan Yu’s deification is already assured.

title: Astute Advisor
description: Guo Jia is a confidant of unparalleled foresight – to ignore his counsel is to invite failure and defeat.

title: Diligent Agriculturalist
description: Using his ability to manage food supplies with tireless efficiency, Han Fu is a most valuable logistician.

title: Tireless Insurgent
description: Insurrection is in Han Sui’s blood. To him, subservience cannot be permanent.

title: The Most Powerful
description: I am He Man, the devil who shoots across the sky! Who dares challenge me?

title: Leader of the People
description: With unwavering faith, He Yi inspires others to follow in his righteous footsteps.

title: Fierce Beast
description: With a head shaped like a leopard’s and ape-like shoulders, Hua Xiong’s ferocity is matched by his appearance.

title: Unreadable Warrior
description: His outward demeanour belies his real allegiances – Huang Gai truly is the very definition of inscrutability.

title: Wielder of the Heavenly Way
description: All uprisings, no matter how widespread, stand little chance of success without strong leadership.

title: of the Ageless Strength
description: The venerable Huang Zhong, to whom age is just a number, is frequently underestimated in battle.

title: Ranged Ambusher
description: Huang Zu likes to start offensives on the front foot, from a safe distance and out of sight.

title: Aged General
description: In the brutal business of war, there is no better teacher than experience.

title: Short-sighted Peacekeeper
description: Jia Long may dedicate much time to forethought, yet still lacks caution now and then.

title: The Blade in the Dark
description: Decisions made in secret can have the deadliest outcomes.

title: Budding Commander
description: Known for being an expert general despite his inexperience, Jiang Wei has a precocious talent for war.

title: Master Scholar
description: Kong Rong claims descent from the great Confucius himself, attested to by his remarkable wit and scholarly fame.

title: Pure Conversationalist
description: A master at the art of Qingtan, Kong Zhou utilises discussion and debate as a means of intellectual self-improvement.

title: The Rising Sun
description: As surely as the sun rises, the Lady will always endeavour to get her way.

title: Elegant Survivor
description: To step between warring factions is quite the task. To be loved by both? Quite the accomplishment.

title: Keeper of Secrets
description: Li Han draws information to himself; so well-regarded is his knowledge that he often fears his life is jeopardised by what he knows.

title: Vicious Shadow
description: Behind every despot’s schemes is the intellect of a consummate strategist.

title: Daring Errant
description: For some men, war is a chance to prove one’s self and seek adventure.

title: Virtuous Idealist
description: Despite having come from modest beginnings, the blood of ancient Han emperors flows through Liu Bei’s veins.

title: Gentleman of the Han
description: A man seldom ruffled, Liu Biao demonstrates his aristocratic pedigree through stable officiality.

title: Generous Attendant
description: In spite of the harsh realities of palace life, Liu Dai conducts himself according to his nature: with kindness and benevolence.

title: Former Emperor
description: While no longer leading their people, they still strive to bring peace to the land.

title: Opportunistic Ruler
description: Some men just want to watch the world burn, while others use the opportunities placed before them.

title: Welcoming Magistrate
description: Liu Yao appears to be a ‘yes’ man, but is nevertheless known for his staunch incorruptibility.

title: Prosperous Trader
description: Liu Yu’s rapport with foreigners and minorities has enabled him to amass considerable wealth from trade.

title: Proponent of Peace
description: A timid and suspicious noble, Liu Zhang displays a willingness to avoid war, even if that means surrender.

title: Warrior Without Equal
description: With unpredictable loyalty and unsurpassed martial skill, Lü Bu is the most dangerous warrior beneath the heavens.

title: Go Master
description: Go is not just an abstract game of strategy – it is a measure of one’s aptitude in tactical forethought.

title: Late Scholar
description: Despite becoming literate late on in his career, Lü Meng has proved himself a most able scholar.

title: Charitable Envoy
description: Ever the philanthropic diplomat, Lu Su’s affluence empowers his charitable nature.

title: Scholar General
description: Equal parts brains and brawn, Lu Xun can oversee both civil and military matters.

title: Most-brilliant Warrior
description: With a complexion like jade and eyes like shooting stars, Ma Chao is a warrior truly brilliant in appearance.

title: Fraternal Warrior
description: There are few things more important to Ma Dai than bloodline and family.

title: Protector of the West
description: Ma Teng may treat his friends well, but he remains merciless with the Han's enemies.

title: Dependable Administrator
description: In these interesting times of fluctuating allegiances, the steadfast loyalty of Mi Zhu can always be relied upon.

title: White Horse General
description: Pang De is an unrelenting force, whose avowed enemies know they must face him sooner or later.

title: Fledgling Phoenix
description: Having risen from the ashes of obscurity, the 'Crown of Learned Men' is an advisor of the highest esteem.

title: Virtuous Outrider
description: Whether in charge of brigands or soldiers, one must lead by example, always riding at the head of the host.

title: Southern Gentleman
description: If you can't run with the big dogs, stay beneath your rock

title: Warden of the Pearl River
description: We have long observed these lands, and our enemies challenge us at their peril!

title: Governor Shi
description: With his long and distinguished record of sophisticated service, Shi Xie is destined for stately eminence.

title: Complacent Administrator
description: I have no strong feelings one way or the other.

title: Silver Eminence
description: If you cannot fight, defend. If you cannot defend, flee. If you cannot flee, surrender. If you cannot surrender, die!

title: The Little Conqueror
description: Sun Ce has been likened to the warrior-kings of old, with an aptitude for military leadership that belies his youth.

title: Tiger of Jiangdong
description: Claiming ancestry with the renowned military strategist Sun Tzu, the fearless Sun Jian has war flowing through his veins.

title: Upstanding Loyalist
description: Sun Qian’s word is an unwavering bond.

title: Emerald-eyed Administrator
description: Striking looks and a sturdy frame betokens Sun Quan’s great nobility, heroism and longevity.

title: of Exceptional Dexterity
description: From horse-riding to archery, Taishi Ci excels in all manner of physical pursuits.

title: Benevolent Arbiter
description: Tao Qian may be a highly influential and ambitious figure, but expansionism is not on his personal agenda.

title: Ardent Educator
description: A keen imparter of knowledge, even when it is neither wanted nor welcome.

title: The Righteous Hero
description: Never can it be said that Wang Xiu was ever disloyal, dishonourable or unwilling to come to the aid of those he serves.

title: Disobedient Tiger
description: For the distrustful Wei Yan, a violent betrayal always simmers below the surface.

title: Fierce Firebrand
description: If only Wen Chou were here, I’d have nothing to fear!

title: Southern Rebel
description: You can take my lands, but you'll never take my freedom. Oh, oh you actually can?

title: Hot-headed Officer
description: Those who know Xiahou Dun know not to get on his bad side.

title: The One-eyed Exile
description: You really don't want to know what he did with his eye after losing it to that arrow…

title: Maker of Ways
description: When it comes to military logistics, where there’s a will, Xiahou Yuan has a way.

title: Tiger Fool
description: Xu Chu is a man of simple thoughts and principles, but an impressive warrior who fights with a bestial rage.

title: Resentful Underling
description: One day you'll see, oh you'll see, you'll ALL see!

title: Guardian of the Gates
description: When assigned to guardianship, Xu Huang is an immovable sentinel, requiring a tremendous effort to bypass.

title: Disguised Diplomat
description: His body may be in one place, but his heart is in quite another.

title: Gentleman Attendant
description: A member of the learned scholar-gentry, Xun You is a profound thinker of great insight.

title: The White Tiger
description: I am Yan Baihu, the White Tiger, hear my roar!

title: Valiant Vanguard
description: A foremost general of considerable military prowess, the gutsy Yan Liang is unmatched among ordinary warriors.

title: Tiger Cub
description: The most furious cub may not necessarily become the most ferocious tiger.

title: Enforcer of the Law
description: As an imperious, by-the-book disciplinarian, Yu Jin rules his subordinates with fear and drilled-in obedience.

title: Favoured Son
description: To be chosen is an accolade in its own right. To take the reigns of one's own lineage? Perhaps that is a blessing.

title: Preeminent Commander
description: Yuan Shao's astuteness, dignity and arrogance are the mark of his ancestors, many of whom served emperors past.

title: Ambitious Powermonger
description: Yuan Shu is an ambitious but overconfident individual – time will tell whether such qualities shall trip him or aid his desires.

title: The Lion of Yangping
description: What Yue Jin lacks in stature he makes up for in fierceness, fearlessness, and deadliness with his bow.

title: Flowing Calligrapher
description: Such graceful skills with ink and brush are the mark a man of great education and scholarly puissance.

title: Courageous General
description: Zhang He’s fearlessness enables him to retain his composure when having to adapt to unfavourable situations.

title: Slayer of Tyrants
description: The unjust rulers of the old regime shall perish.

title: The Heavenly Dragon General
description: The model of professionalism and organisation, Zhang Liao has heavenly leadership skills.

title: Celestial Master
description: Just as water penetrates mountains, Zhang Lu always seeks to overcome hardness by his own accord.

title: King of Black Mountain
description: With his scores of followers, the bandit leader known as 'Flying Swallow' wields the influence of a king.

title: Ignored Warlord
description: What is the fate of he who is forsaken and unjustly distrusted by his fellow warlords? Only heaven knows.

title: Light in the Dark
description: In the darkest times of war, the auras of the most resplendent warriors gleam brightest.

title: Bandit Queen
description: Hell-bent on plunder, Zheng Jiang goes to unspeakable lengths to obtain her loot.

title: Reformed Brigand
description: Do not let Zhou Tai's chequered past and grim expression mislead you - he will serve his master with a fierce loyalty.

title: Melodic Strategist
description: If there is a mistake in the tune, Zhou Yu will look up.

title: Inconstant Administrator
description: Just because you did it one way in the past, is no reason to do it the same way now!

title: Bookish Scholar
description: Having studied history and poetry in years past, Zhuge Jin is a man who appreciates scholarship.

title: Sleeping Dragon
description: A peerless genius and insightful strategist, there are few situations that Zhuge Liang’s astute intellect cannot overcome.

title: Astrologer
description: The movement of the celestial bodies are there to guide us; this one has the talent to interpret them.

title: Monk
description: This one has given themselves fully to the Way, to become enlightened and to enlighten others.

title: Philosopher
description: This person understands that all knowledge is a stepping stone to greater questions and is unafraid to grapple with the unknown.

title: Sorcerer
description: It is whispered that this one can talk with the spirits to call upon their powers to heal, or if angered, curse others.

title: Writer
description: A good writer keeps things clear and succinct.

title: Brewer
description: China has many noble professions, but this person has chosen the noblest: to quench people’s thirst with beer.

title: Builder
description: Realising a building not only requires the technical skill to build, but the imagination to envision and design it.

title: Farmer
description: When life’s chaos threatens to overwhelm, this one takes to the field to clear their mind by working the land.

title: Jade Carver
description: Years of practice have given this one the precision and patience needed to carve jade.

title: Potter
description: I have everything - large bowls, small bowls, tiny bowls. A cup? Are you sure you wouldn’t rather have a nice bowl instead?

title: Advisor
description: This person possesses one of those invaluable minds that can quickly understand facts and consider the possibilities from all angles.

title: Singer
description: When this one sings, they manage to carry the original intention of the music while imbuing it with something new.

title: Fortune-teller
description: I can tell you your future, but I cannot guarantee whether or not you will be glad of what you hear.

title: Musician
description: When this one plays, the world pauses for a short while to listen.

title: Physician
description: When someone falls ill, they call on this person to unblock their Qi and restore balance.

title: Observant Advisor
description: Sima Wei's confidante; often sees things that others do not

title: Loyal Officer
description: Although subordinate to Sima Yue, he is a loyal and capable advisor

title: Facilitator
description: Has fought Li Han for years, now works on behalf of Sima Ai, fighting wars or making deals wherever needed

title: Renowned Scholar
description: Famed thoughout the realm as a gifted writer and literary critic. However, his ability as a commander remains... questionable.

title: Skilled Mediator
description: Sima Ying's close advisor, known for being capable and loyal

title: Insightful Survivalist
description: This one is gifted with insight and adamant perseverance.

title: Cunning Clerk
description: Assistant and advisor to Sima Wei - his wily observations may direct one to glory or to ruin

title: Central Army Protector
description: A talented general who has seen dynasties fall as his loyalties shifted

title: Principled Administrator
description: I am afraid I cannot allow that. You see, in sub-section five, paragraph nine...

title: Jade Carver
description: Sima Liang's son. Not being titled as prince has given him a desire to prove his worth

title: Imperious Regent
description: A regent is like air; unseen and barely felt, but vital all the same.

title: Outsider Heir
description: Sima Liang's son and heir, considered an outsider but not to be underestimated

title: Rightful Regent
description: Son of the legendary Sima Yi, he has watched the Jin dynasty scuffle in his shadow.

title: Usurper Prince
description: The Jin dynasty will endure under a wise and deserving emperor - me!

title: Tempestuous General
description: His reputation for belligerence is perhaps undeserved. Not so his famously short temper.

title: Beloved Governor
description: Madness may grip the court, but Sima Ying will always think of his people.

title: Shrewd Defender
description: Sima Yong has a duty to the emperor, and his loyalty will never waver.

title: Imperial Overseer
description: There must be oversight in all things, especially important matters of state.

title: Partisan
description: If I may, my lord, I have a rather compelling argument...

title: Steadfast Preacher
description: Courtier of Sima Jiong's regency. Has strong beliefs and a loose tongue that may cause him trouble

title: Mediator
description: This person knows how to divide the cake in such a way that everyone believes they have the biggest slice.

title: Uncompromising Warrior
description: When fighting for his master, Zhang Fang is not known to concern himself with scruples like 'civilian casualties'

title: Academic
description: This one sees the value of institutionalised learning, and has embraced it.
